pairs: These things the Lord God has revealed to me.
et ecce fictor locustæ in principio germinantium serotini imbris,
And behold, the locust was formed at the beginning of the germination during the latter rains, and behold,
et ecce serotinus post tonsionem regis.
the latter rains came after the thundering of the king.
when they had finally eaten all the grass in the land,
The Lord has been merciful about this.
These things the Lord God has revealed to me.
et ecce vocabat judicium ad ignem Dominus Deus;
And behold, the Lord God called for judgment unto fire,
et devoravit abyssum multam, et comedit simul partem.
and it devoured the manifold abyss, and it consumed simultaneously in every direction.
The Lord has been merciful about this.
These things the Lord revealed to me.
et ecce Dominus stans super murum litum,
And behold, the Lord was standing near a plastered wall,
et in manu ejus trulla cæmentarii.
and in his hand was a mason’s trowel.
And the Lord said to me,
Ecce ego ponam trullam in medio populi mei Israël;
“Behold, I will place the trowel in the midst of my people Israel.
I will no longer plaster over them.
And the heights of the idol will be demolished,
and the sanctuaries of Israel will be desolate.
et consurgam super domum Jeroboam in gladio.
And I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”
And Amaziah, the priest of Bethel,
sent to Jeroboam king of Israel,
Rebellavit contra te Amos in medio domus Israël;
“Amos has rebelled against you in the midst of the house of Israel.
non poterit terra sustinere universos sermones ejus.
The land is not able to withstand all his sermons.
et Israël captivus migrabit de terra sua.
and Israel will be taken captive out of their own land.’”
go out and flee into the land of Judah,
Et in Bethel non adjicies ultra ut prophetes,
And in Bethel, do not prophesy any longer,
because it is the king’s sanctuary,
and it is the house of the kingdom.”
and I am not the son of a prophet,
sed armentarius ego sum vellicans sycomoros.
but I am a herdsman plucking from wild fig trees.
Et tulit me Dominus cum sequerer gregem,
And the Lord took me, when I was following the flock,
and the Lord said to me,
And now, hear the word of the Lord:
Tu dicis: Non prophetabis super Israël,
You say, “You will not prophesy about Israel,
et non stillabis super domum idoli.
and you will not rain your words upon the house of the idol.”
“Your wife will fornicate in the city,
et filiæ tuæ in gladio cadent,
and your sons and your daughters will fall by the sword,
and your soil will be measured with a string.
et tu in terra polluta morieris,
And you will die on polluted land,
et Israël captivus migrabit de terra sua.
and Israel will be taken into captivity out of their land.”
